tools.name: workiz_list_jobs
tools.description: List jobs, most recently scheduled first (sorted by JobDateTime, descending). Filter by start date, open-only, and status; page with offset/records (max 100). Without start_date Workiz returns the last 14 days. Workiz: GET /job/all/.

tools.name: workiz_get_job
tools.description: Fetch one job by UUID: schedule, status, client contact and address, totals and amount due, notes, tags and assigned team. Workiz: GET /job/get/{UUID}/.

tools.name: workiz_list_leads
tools.description: List leads, most recent first (sorted by LeadDateTime, descending). Filter by start date, open-only, and status; page with offset/records (max 100). Workiz: GET /lead/all/.

tools.name: workiz_get_lead
tools.description: Fetch one lead by UUID: schedule, status, client contact and address, source, notes and assigned team. Workiz: GET /lead/get/{UUID}/.

tools.name: workiz_list_team
tools.description: List the account's active team members: id, name, role, whether they are a field tech, email, service areas and skills. Use the name to assign people to jobs or leads. Workiz: GET /team/all/.

tools.name: workiz_get_team_member
tools.description: Fetch one team member by user id: name, role, field-tech flag, email, service areas, skills and active status. Workiz: GET /team/get/{USER_ID}.

tools.name: workiz_list_time_off
tools.description: List FUTURE time off (start, end, userName — 'Entire Business' for company-wide closures). Set all=true to include every user and company time off. Useful before scheduling. Workiz: GET /TimeOff/get/.

tools.name: workiz_get_user_time_off
tools.description: List one team member's FUTURE time off, by their name. Workiz: GET /TimeOff/get/{USER_NAME}.

tools.name: workiz_create_job
tools.description: WRITE: create a new job (schedule, client contact and address, type, source, notes). Returns the new job's UUID, ClientId and app link. Workiz: POST /job/create/.

tools.name: workiz_update_job
tools.description: WRITE: update fields on an existing job — status/sub-status, reschedule (JobDateTime/JobEndDateTime), contact, address, type, source, notes, tags. Only the fields you pass are sent. Workiz: POST /job/update/.

tools.name: workiz_assign_job
tools.description: WRITE: assign a team member (by name) to a job. Reversible with workiz_unassign_job. Workiz: POST /job/assign/.

tools.name: workiz_unassign_job
tools.description: WRITE: remove a team member (by name) from a job. Reversible with workiz_assign_job. Workiz: POST /job/unassign/.

tools.name: workiz_create_lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a new lead (client contact and address, requested time, job type, source, notes). Returns the new lead's UUID, ClientId and app link. Workiz: POST /lead/create/.

tools.name: workiz_update_lead
tools.description: WRITE: update fields on an existing lead — status, schedule, contact, address, type, source, notes, tags. Only the fields you pass are sent. Workiz: POST /lead/update/.

tools.name: workiz_assign_lead
tools.description: WRITE: assign a team member (by name) to a lead. Reversible with workiz_unassign_lead. Workiz: POST /lead/assign/.

tools.name: workiz_unassign_lead
tools.description: WRITE: remove a team member (by name) from a lead. Reversible with workiz_assign_lead. Workiz: POST /lead/unassign/.

tools.name: workiz_convert_lead_to_job
tools.description: WRITE (no API undo): convert a lead into a job. Creates a new job from the lead and returns its UUID and link; the API cannot reverse the conversion. Workiz: POST /lead/convert/.

tools.name: workiz_mark_lead_lost
tools.description: WRITE: mark a lead as lost. Reversible with workiz_activate_lead. Workiz: POST /lead/markLost/{UUID}/.

tools.name: workiz_activate_lead
tools.description: WRITE: change a lost lead back to active. Workiz: POST /lead/activate/{UUID}/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: workiz_list_team, workiz_get_team_member · Private data: workiz_list_jobs, workiz_get_job, workiz_list_leads, workiz_get_lead, workiz_create_job, workiz_update_job, workiz_create_lead, workiz_update_lead · Public sink: workiz_list_team, workiz_get_team_member, workiz_create_job, workiz_update_job, workiz_assign_job, workiz_unassign_job, workiz_create_lead, workiz_update_lead, workiz_assign_lead, workiz_unassign_lead, workiz_convert_lead_to_job, workiz_mark_lead_lost, workiz_activate_lead · Destructive: workiz_unassign_job, workiz_unassign_lead.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: workiz_list_team, workiz_get_team_member · Private data: workiz_list_jobs, workiz_get_job, workiz_list_leads, workiz_get_lead, workiz_create_job, workiz_update_job, workiz_create_lead, workiz_update_lead · Public sink: workiz_list_team, workiz_get_team_member, workiz_create_job, workiz_update_job, workiz_assign_job, workiz_unassign_job, workiz_create_lead, workiz_update_lead, workiz_assign_lead, workiz_unassign_lead, workiz_convert_lead_to_job, workiz_mark_lead_lost, workiz_activate_lead · Destructive: workiz_unassign_job, workiz_unassign_lead

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
